text:
Review of Acne Treatment with Dr. Pannarat After 2 Years! (2024-2026) ✨

Before: Showing my long-standing acne problem. I'd tried countless clinics, including the supposedly good Pink House, Green House, and Blue House, but nothing worked. I'd spent tens of thousands of baht and felt completely discouraged.

Then, my current boyfriend recommended Dr. Pannarat. This gave me renewed hope and motivation to try acne treatment again. And the results are amazing! I'm so happy this day has finally arrived.

Dr. Pannarat is incredibly kind. She doesn't rush patients and treats them with the genuine intention of curing me. Before treatment, she checks my skin condition and plans a treatment program, considering my budget. I told her I could afford no more than 3,000 baht a month, and she said that was perfect. I was overjoyed!

And then, today, she said I won't need to take medication anymore! I almost cried. She gave me topical medication, a face wash, and sunscreen, and said we'd see each other again in 3 months.

Honestly, not needing medication anymore was the last thing I'd wanted to hear. I never thought this day would come. A day without acne and no medication because I'm planning to donate blood! I'm so happy because it's been two years since I last donated blood, and now I'll be able to donate again. 🩸
